name: open-optcg
description: Play the One Piece Card Game against AI opponents in the browser or the terminal, on an open-source deterministic rules engine.

scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.verify:browser: pnpm browser:check && pnpm browser:parity && pnpm fixtures:check && pnpm web:e2e
scripts.test:engine: vitest run test/engine.test.ts test/engine-limits.test.ts test/mechanics.test.ts test/removal.test.ts test/don-sequence.test.ts test/hidden-knowledge.test.ts test/decision-scenarios.test.ts
scripts.web:e2e: pnpm web:build --with-art && pnpm get-cards:build && playwright test -c test/playwright.config.ts
scripts.web:e2e:ci: pnpm web:build && pnpm get-cards:build && playwright test -c test/playwright.config.ts --grep-invert @art
